
1. Sentry       — 1 value  (SENTRY_DSN)
2. Grafana      — 1 value  (GRAFANA_API_KEY)
3. EnsembleData — 1 value  (ENSEMBLEDATA_TOKEN)  ← paid plan
4. RapidAPI     — 1 value  (RAPIDAPI_KEY)         ← paid plan


1. SENTRY — Free Account
   Website: https://sentry.io

What it is: Catches and reports errors in the app automatically.

Steps:
  1. Go to https://sentry.io and click "Get Started For Free"
  2. Sign up with your email (or Google/GitHub)
  3. Create an Organisation — name it anything (e.g. "ValidDs")
  4. Create a Project:
       - Click "Projects" → "Create Project"
       - Choose "Node.js" as the platform
       - Name it "validds-backend"
       - Click "Create Project"
  5. After creation, Sentry shows you a DSN key.
     It looks like:
       https://abc123@o987654.ingest.sentry.io/1234567
  6. Copy that value and send it to us.

   Send: SENTRY_DSN (the long URL above)


2. GRAFANA — Free Account
   Website: https://grafana.com

What it is: Displays charts and performance stats for the app.

Steps:
  1. Go to https://grafana.com and click "Create free account"
  2. Sign up with your email
  3. You will be asked to create a "Stack" — name it "ValidDs"
     and choose the region closest to your server
  4. Once in the dashboard:
       - Go to "My Account" → "Security" → "API Keys"
       - Click "Add API Key"
       - Give it a name (e.g. "validds-backend")
       - Set the Role to "Editor"
       - Click "Create" and copy the key shown
  5. Send the key to us.

   Send: GRAFANA_API_KEY (the long key from step 4)


3. ENSEMBLEDATA — Paid Account (subscribe to Basic/Starter plan)
   Website: https://www.ensembledata.com

What it is: Provides TikTok trending data for our product
            research features.

Steps:
  1. Go to https://www.ensembledata.com
  2. Click "Get Started" and sign up with your email
  3. Verify your email and log in
  4. Go to "Pricing" and subscribe to the smallest/cheapest
     paid plan available (e.g. Starter or Basic)
  5. After subscribing, go to your Dashboard
  6. Your API token is shown on the Dashboard home page
  7. Copy it and send it to us.

   Send: ENSEMBLEDATA_TOKEN (the token from your dashboard)


4. RAPIDAPI — Paid Account (subscribe to smallest plan)
   Website: https://rapidapi.com
   API:     https://rapidapi.com/Lundehund/api/tiktok-creative-center-api

What it is: Provides additional TikTok trend and ad data
            as a backup data source.

Steps:
  1. Go to https://rapidapi.com and click "Sign Up"
     Register with your email, Google, or GitHub
  2. Once logged in, go directly to this page:
     https://rapidapi.com/Lundehund/api/tiktok-creative-center-api
  3. Click the "Pricing" tab
  4. Subscribe to the smallest paid plan available
  5. After subscribing, click the "Endpoints" tab
  6. In the code panel on the right, find the header:
       "X-RapidAPI-Key": "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx..."
     That value is your API key.
     (You can also find it at:
      Developer Dashboard → Apps → Default App → API Key)
  7. Copy the key and send it to us.

   Send: RAPIDAPI_KEY (the long string from the header)




Please send all of the following values:

  [ ] SENTRY_DSN
  [ ] GRAFANA_API_KEY
  [ ] ENSEMBLEDATA_TOKEN
  [ ] RAPIDAPI_KEY

If you are not able to get anyone, you can send me the account credentials.
